items.html: When ZA and the two Tevunot rise up to the upper Bina, then ZA together with Binot is called "He." And the reason, with a preface we shall give you regarding the matter of inclusion, mentioned in many places, is that wherever the lower one rises above into the place of the upper one, being included there with him, the upper one stands in the discernment of Panim [face], and the lower one stands there in the discernment of his Achoraim [back]. And by this you will understand this matter, for this Tevuna comes out from the Achoraim of the upper Bina, and those Achoraim of Bina are names of Elokim, as is known, as is written, may it be explained, that all the Achoraim are names of Elokim.
